propositions: Destructive repair (fsck and doctor) must acquire durable pause ownership via refs/reconciler/gate before mutation, replacing GitHub-only gh workflow disable/enable safety.
Pause acquisition requires git user.email identity; missing identity aborts before any pause write or repair with explicit error.
Repair entry is fail-closed: pause creation, lock check, and mutation all succeed or none execute; a pre-existing pause, held lock, or CAS uncertainty aborts.

Pause cleanup must verify ownership by comparing reason to invocation token and delete only by the same observed OID; a changed or replaced pause is never cleared and cleanup failure leaves pause for operator recovery.
The repair sequence and its repair effects remain unchanged; existing fsck and doctor non-repair behavior and public vocabulary are preserved.

A two-clone contention test proves ownership replacement cannot clear another actor's pause; local, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab, and bare environments all share the same pause behavior without gh binary dependency.
